scope: All 561 single numerical attributes, same three development splits, three fold-refitted learners. No reduction or outer testing.
association_score: Mean observed W minus mean permutation W across the three fitting folds; primary descriptive rank score
predictive_gain: Inner validation Brier of fold-training global mean minus single-attribute Brier
constants: Original scaling, k=5, beta=1,zeta=.1 and bandwidth rules
comparison: Spearman coefficient only, no independent-attribute or significance claim; stable permutation group used for description only
limitations: Marginal diagnosis cannot exclude feature interactions; previously used development folds are not fresh test evidence
